# lytt

> lytt is a private AI chat assistant for code, writing and everyday questions. It runs on dedicated hardware with Ollama, and users chat with it through this website after creating an account.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lytt.arlenh7.com/): what lytt is, with a real unedited exchange
- [Sign up](https://lytt.arlenh7.com/signup): create an account, 13 and older
- [Privacy policy](https://lytt.arlenh7.com/privacy): what is collected, where it is stored, and how to delete it
- [Terms of use](https://lytt.arlenh7.com/terms): rules and limits of the service

## Notes for AI agents

- Chat requires a signed-in account. There is no public API.
- Do not create accounts or send messages automatically. The terms forbid it.
